claim: Preserve cold-analysis resolution while reusing parsing. No improved semantic coverage is claimed.
precommit: Commit this policy and complete mutation corpus before implementation. Preserve every mutation and failed observation; corrective measurements get distinct records.
stages: Collect normalized dirty paths and explicit structural-change reasons.
Invalidate source-owned nodes and all incident edges; conservatively every source file is a resolution dependent, including imports, facades, receiver hints, and candidate-set changes.

Re-extract changed files, reconstruct the source graph in the cold project loader's sorted relative-path order from complete cached extraction outputs, then run full project-wide resolution. Apply cold persisted-graph reconciliation.

batch_contract.duplicate_paths: Normalize before coalescing; the last operation wins.
batch_contract.path_safety: Project-relative supported source paths only; reject absolute paths and parent traversal before changing state.

fallback.dirty_ratio: Number of unique dirty paths divided by max(before_owned_source_file_count, after_owned_source_file_count). Full parsing only when this ratio is greater than 0.5, not equal. Structural reasons also force full parsing.
fallback.normal_update: Full project-wide resolution with clean-file parsing reuse is normal operation, not a fallback.

correctness_gate.comparison: Canonical complete node records and complete edge records, including exact node IDs, endpoints, confidence and every edge attribute; compare Calls and test relationships, not just counts.
correctness_gate.oracle: Fresh cold analysis of the same current sources and configuration after every mutation, with identical persisted reconciliation when present.
correctness_gate.first_required: Three-file Rust facade export rename: old Calls edge disappears; exactly one file parsed and two reused; no full parsing fallback.
correctness_gate.pass: Every corpus mutation, project integration case, and scaling mutation must match cold analysis exactly. Any mismatch fails the release gate, regardless of speed.
correctness_gate.known_misses: Preserve cold misses identically, including Go function-value callbacks, dynamic dispatch, and intent search. Do not repair resolution in this work.

measurement.scaling: Use the corpus's frozen languages, sizes and mutations once, serially.
measurement.memory: GNU time process peak RSS; update process includes its initial cold cache construction and preceding mutations. Report that limitation.
measurement.cost_gate: None. Expose regressions; they cannot excuse inequality.
measurement.fallback_reporting: Publish count, denominator, percentage and reasons prominently, including threshold-driven full parsing.

implementation_gates: complete mutation and project integration tests
clippy all targets with warnings denied
four-platform release rehearsal before a release
watcher_gate: No watcher implementation or public watcher claim until incremental equality and required implementation gates pass.
